name: Inbin
description: Inbin turns email into a structured, trust-labeled data source for Claude. Every message arriving at your Inbin inbox is extracted against your schema, checked verbatim against the source by a hallucination guard, and served as typed JSON. Each field carries a trust label (typed vs untrusted text a stranger wrote), each event carries the sender's SPF/DKIM/DMARC verdicts, and provenance is channel-derived, so nothing in an email's content can claim authority. Claude can list, search, and aggregate events server-side, wait for confirmation emails to complete signup flows, record decisions, and share individual events across applications by id instead of resending content.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Inbin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Inbin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.inbin.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Inbin MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inbin lists 24 MCP tools, including await_confirmation, backfill_email, check_decisions, describe_schema, get_application, get_event, list_apps, list_events, list_inboxes, list_views, operative_view, and query_events.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Inbin?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Inbin in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Inbin requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Inbin is developed by Inbin. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
